reply.text:
I can't give you an amount for melatonin or any supplement. For that, and for whether it's right for you at all, check with a doctor or pharmacist. In general terms, melatonin is a sleep-timing aid and not a recovery booster, so it won't do much for muscle repair by itself.

The things that move recovery most are boring and free: a consistent bedtime and wake time, a dark and cool room, screens down before bed, and caffeine kept to the morning. If your sleep is poor, tell me how training has been feeling and I can look at your recent load to see whether that's part of it.
